name: The Horizontal Horizon
prompt: Set a huge saffron observation wheel almost flat on low rollers. Gondolas at its outer edge dip into narrow viewing trenches and rise into a sunny orchard. A family in one open gondola reaches up for a low-hanging pear.

name: The Wheel of Borrowed Rooms
prompt: Fasten whole furnished balconies to an open skeletal wheel. A kitchen, workshop and bedroom rotate past a single landing. Neighbours exchange dishes or books in the few seconds when their room meets the stationary platform.

name: The Paper Waterwheel
prompt: Construct a broad white wheel of folded paper cups above a dark trough. Clear water fills each cup to turn the wheel, while tiny riders sit in dry bamboo gondolas between them. One flattened cup is being replaced.

name: The Crescent Ride
prompt: Build a huge open crescent on a curved ground rail, with separate lime-green seats nested along its inner arc. It rocks slowly from tip to tip. Children wait on the ground where the lower horn touches down.

name: The Threadbare Wheel
prompt: Suspend a fragile wheel outline in indigo thread between two red pylons. White wicker seats travel around its circumference on an almost invisible cable. At the top, one rider appears momentarily seated in empty sky.
